plugins.name: Mistral Vibe Bridge
plugins.description: Mistral Bridge fork that reproduces the official Mistral Vibe CLI request fingerprint (call_source=vibe_code, full telemetry metadata, Vibe User-Agent, x-affinity) so requests bill to the Vibe allowance. Also folds developer roles to system, fixing Mistral 422s for Responses-API clients.
plugins.author: baozipai

zh-CN.description: Mistral Bridge 分叉版：完整复刻官方 Vibe CLI 请求指纹（call_source=vibe_code、全套遥测 metadata、Vibe User-Agent、x-affinity），使请求计入 Vibe 额度；并将 developer 角色折叠为 system，修复 Responses 客户端的 422。
